The evaluators identified this as false by checking it against Texas's restriction on campaign-related apparel [e1]. This documents a contemporary OpenAI assistant confidently presenting false factual information within the January 1–March 10, 2024 target period, supporting the claim's continuing-occurrence reading [e1].
limitations: This example does not establish how frequently such errors occurred across OpenAI products.
The response does not establish the internal mechanism that produced the false assertion.
The evidence does not identify the particular OpenAI effort referenced in the older quotation; support follows the contract's reading that includes contemporary assistants such as GPT-4.
